Its registered and corporate offices are at New Delhi. The company employed 16,689 regular employees (Executives: 12,319 and Non- executives: 4,370) as on 31.03.2025. The authorized and paid up capital of the Company was Rs. 16,600 crores and Rs. 9,696.7 crores respectively as on 31.03.2025.
